summary: Audit Phase 2: the full MOCK TEST journey, tested as a real student in the web preview at 390x844. I used the QA learner (7004186276) and made exactly ONE new real attempt: JEE Main PYQ 22 Jan 2025 Shift 1 (set jee-main-pyq-2025-01-22-s1, attempt 7f61a0ac-7c68-49ff-b59d-256a6f82ec87, 75 Q, 180 min). It was submitted manually with 7 answered and 1 marked, and the score is -2/300. No app code was changed. WORKS: sign-in to Home in 0.97 s. PYQ list in 1.6 s. Set detail and preflight. Start to player in 0.84 s. First question image painted at 1.63 s. All 77 question images were in about 5.4 s (all 200, none failed, no retry buttons). The timer starts at 3:00:00 and counts down, and it is not based on the device clock: with Date shifted +2 h it still showed the correct remaining time. Every answer reached 'Saved' (PUT 0.17-0.21 s). MCQ, integer, mark for review, palette jump, subject tabs, next and prev all work. Integer '2.5' shows 'Enter an exact integer. Decimals and letters are not accepted. Your draft has not been scored.' and stays '1 pending' until a valid '7' is entered, which then saves. Offline: 2 answers were kept as drafts, the header showed 'Offline' and there was no crash. After going back online they synced to Saved in 3.3 s. After a reload all 7 answers and the 1 mark were still there and the timer kept running. Home showed a Continue card ('7/75 saved · 2:56:51 LEFT'), and My Tests In progress listed the attempt with Resume. The submit sheet counts were correct (Maths 4/1/21, Physics 3/0/22, Chemistry 0/0/25, total 7/1/68). Submit to share gate took 0.36 s. The gate appears before the result; tapping back and reopening shows the gate again. Tapping share opened an api.whatsapp.com popup, the green 'Shukriya' showed at 3.1 s (the 3 s fallback, because the headless tab never became hidden) and the result opened at 4.1 s. Analysis showed the score card, 1 correct / 6 incorrect / 68 skipped, and subject-wise marks. I pinned 2 dreams through Rank -> College predictor -> rank-seat-N-dream. result-dream then showed 'IS MOCK MEIN -2/300' with 165 and 166 MARKS DOOR (target 163 and 164 plus 2, which is correct). Solutions show the answer key and the supplied solution image. My Tests Completed lists the new attempt (-2/300, 14.3%). The Home Continue card disappears and Home Dream shows 'LAST MOCK -2/300'. There were no requests over 2 s. The only console error is the known 401 on /auth/refresh before login. ISSUES: see the lists below. The main 100k risks are the image bandwidth through the single FastAPI proxy, the synchronized 5 s polling at 00:00, and losing last-second answers. Deprecated packages detected: none checked or flagged in the files reviewed.

critical.issue: 100k scale: every question or solution PNG goes through the single FastAPI proxy. Each one costs one Mongo jar read, and the whole body is buffered in memory (r.content). Responses are 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'. One paper open = 77 images, 7.3 MB (average 95 KB, largest 156 KB; not 450 KB). One result open = 190 more images, 12.0 MB (77 question images again + 113 solution images, 4.7 MB). A reload or reopen downloads everything again: the cache is only an in-memory 48 MB per session. For 100k students: about 730 GB and 7.7M proxied requests at paper open, plus about 1.2 TB and 19M requests when results open at 00:00. The upstream pool is limited to 400 connections, uvicorn runs 1 worker with --reload, and the upstream timeout is 30 s. Fix: serve these as immutable, cacheable images from a CDN using signed, short-lived URLs (or long private max-age + ETag), and do not preload all solutions on result open.

minor.issue: Result Progress and Rank tabs say 'Progress journey unavailable' and 'Reliable rank estimate unavailable' for this real 75 Q / 180 min original-score JEE Main paper. The Dream meter on the same screen counts it as a full mock ('IS MOCK MEIN'), so the app contradicts itself. This comes from the canonical website. Please confirm whether PYQ papers should qualify.

Upstream timeout or error becomes a 503 with the message 'Connection interrupted... Please try again.' and no Retry-After header. Clients therefore retry on their own fixed schedule (see the auto-submit review).

ui_bugs.component: Player answer lock while an image is missing
ui_bugs.issue: attempt/[id].tsx:87-88 sets disabled = ... || missingImage, so a question cannot be answered until its image has painted. Under load, or if one image fails, the student is locked out of that question while the timer keeps running. Text options ('Option 1, as printed in the source') could still be answerable.

The header shows only 'Offline' and hides the pending count ('2 pending'), because saveState prefers Offline (attempt/[id].tsx:90). The error box also says 'Connection interrupted... Please try again.' although no user action is needed; it re-syncs on its own.
After a reload or Resume the player opens at Q1 of Maths instead of the last question viewed.
'3:17 used' is ambiguous: it was 3 min 17 s, but a student can read it as 3 h 17 m. Add units (3m 17s).

integration_issues.issue: The lock is stored only on the device (mission/gate.ts, share_gate.<attemptId> in storage). On another phone or browser, or after clearing storage, the result opens with no gate (verified: in a fresh browser context, My Tests -> Open result showed the result directly). On web, the 3 s fallback in share.ts watchReturn also unlocks without any share: verified, the result opened 4.1 s after tapping, while the WhatsApp tab was still open.

In a fresh browser context, Home Dream said 'Pehla full JEE Main mock do' even though the account has many completed full mocks. LAST MOCK only appears after a result screen has been opened on this device, so last mock and dreams are device-local, not tied to the account (related to the Phase 1 dream bugs).

flush() saves drafts one PUT at a time. After any failure, postpone() blocks ALL saves for 2 s, then 4 s, 8 s, up to 30 s (plus jitter). One failed PUT in the last 30 s (likely at 100k load) can push pending answers past the deadline, where they are dropped ('Late drafts are not scored'). There is no faster retry and no parallel saving near the deadline.

issues: The page has 2 inputs with placeholder 'e.g. 180' (one hidden) and has no testID on the marks input, so automation needs :visible. Add testIDs to the marks and percentile inputs.

action_items: CRITICAL (100k): Move question and solution PNGs off the FastAPI proxy. Use cacheable or immutable CDN URLs (signed, short-lived) instead of 'no-store'. Keep an on-disk cache for the current attempt so reloads and resumes do not download 7.3 MB again. Do not preload all 113 solution images (4.7 MB) plus 77 question images again on result open; load solutions when the Solutions tab or a question is opened.

HIGH (00:00 storm): useAttempt.ts:176-194. At 0 s every open app sends GET /attempts/{id} (full 75-question payload) right away, then again every exactly 5 s (checking resets after 5000 ms, tick runs every 1 s). There is no jitter, no backoff, no limit, and Retry-After is ignored on errors. Since everyone in a scheduled mock reaches 0 within about 1 s, this is 100k GETs in that second and again every 5 s. Add random jitter of 0-10 s, exponential backoff, a light status-only endpoint, and Retry-After handling.

HIGH: At 0 s, the 5-7 s recover loop (useAttempt.ts:147-157) still runs flush(). Pending drafts send PUTs that fail with 409, and each 409 sends another GET /attempts/{id} (line 112). That is extra load at exactly the peak.

HIGH: The app never POSTs /submit at 00:00. It relies only on the server sealing the attempt when the deadline passes. If the server only seals when a GET or cron runs, every client waits in 'Time's up... confirming' and keeps polling. Confirm server-side auto-seal at the deadline and document it. Consider a server push, or one jittered client POST /submit as a fallback.

HIGH: When the attempt completes, toResult -> router.replace(/result) immediately sends GET /results plus up to 190 image preloads for every student at the same second. Result polling (result/[id].tsx:316-318) does have backoff and jitter, which is good. Stagger the first results fetch randomly (0-15 s) and load images lazily.
HIGH: attempt/[id].tsx:87-88 disables answering until the question image has painted. Allow answering MCQ/integer even when the image is still loading or failed.
MEDIUM: Last-second save risk. Use a short retry (1-2 s) for PUTs in the final 60 s instead of the shared 2-30 s postpone, and save independent questions in parallel or batched.
MEDIUM: Share gate and dream/last-mock are device-local. Decide whether this is intended. A web user is unlocked by the 3 s fallback without sharing.
LOW: Header should show 'Offline · N pending'. Change the offline error wording to 'will sync automatically'. Restore the last viewed question on resume. Add units to the time-used text ('3m 17s').
Confirm with the website why journey and historical-rank are 'unavailable' for a full PYQ attempt while the Dream meter treats it as a full mock.
critical_code_review_comments: Auto-submit at 00:00 (who submits): the SERVER. The app has no auto-POST /submit. useAttempt tick() computes left from the server-anchored monotonic clock (anchor = server_now + performance.now()); when left==0 it calls confirm() = GET /attempts/{id}. If status=='completed' it calls onCompleted -> lockResult (share gate) -> router.replace('/result/{id}') -> loadResult/warmResult GET /results?score_version=original (202 polls with backoff 1.5s*n + up to 0.8s jitter, max 12 polls) -> prepareImages(solutions=true), which queues all question + solution assets (concurrency 6).

Requests every open app sends at 00:00: (1) GET /attempts/{id} immediately, then every ~5 s with no jitter or backoff; (2) recover loop every 5-7 s: flush() PUT /attempts/{id}/answers/{qid} for each leftover draft -> 409 -> extra GET /attempts/{id}; (3) after completion: GET /results (+ polls) and about 190 GET /asset/* images (about 12 MB). On mobile, AppState 'active' also resets retryState.after=0 and runs load()+flush() right away, so students who switch apps near the end retry with no backoff.

Timer anchor: syncClock uses server_now (seconds) when the attempt loads and on each PUT ack; the device wall clock is ignored (verified with Date +2 h). If server_now is a whole number of seconds there is up to 1 s quantization, which is acceptable.
postpone() jitter is only 0-1.5 s and retryState is shared between load and flush, so one failed GET also delays saves.

Proxy (server.py:140-168): fully buffered responses, a Mongo find_one per request (load_jar), and a single uvicorn worker started with --reload in this preview. Not production-grade for 100k concurrent users. Production needs multiple workers or pods and no --reload.
useAttempt.ts is 267 lines and attempt/[id].tsx 387 lines: OK size. testIDs are present on all tested controls.
updated_files: /app/tests/audit2/common.py (new helper with attempt id; no app code changed)

rca_of_issue: 100k risks come from: (a) private no-store PNGs proxied one by one through FastAPI; (b) a deterministic 5 s confirm loop at deadline 0 with no jitter or backoff; (c) the shared exponential postpone blocking saves near the deadline; (d) the answer lock while an image is missing.
